item.title: Using AWS CLI to Search Multiple Files with S3 Select
item.description: Environment aws-cli 2.7.14 Overview I needed to search through CloudFront logs stored in S3. Since Athena was not available, I used S3 Select for the search. However, S3 Select can only search one file at a time. To handle multiple files, I integrated AWS CLI into a shell script. Steps Here are the conditions: The S3 bucket name is target-bucket-name. item.title: Downgrading the AmazonLinux2023 kernel
item.description: Environment Amazon Linux 2023.5.20240819 Overview I upgraded the kernel of AmazonLinux2023 and downgraded some tools that stopped working. This is a record of that operating procedure. Procedure First, check the current kernel status. $uname -r 6.1.102-111.182.amzn2023.x86_64 $ sudo dnf list kernel kernel.x86_64 6.1.92-99.174 amzn2023 @amazonlinux kernel.x86_64 6.1.96-102.177.amzn2023 @amazonlinux kernel.x86_64 6.1.102-111.182.amzn2023 @amazonlinux It is currently at 6.1.102 and will downgrade to 6.1.96. Probably the shortest way. First, downgrade and restart. You can revert to a specific version by specifying “package name - version”.

item.title: Scrum's story point about “not estimating by the hour” is
item.description: Background I usually work as a scrum master in scrum development. I have the developers estimate in story points. Story points are not estimated in “man-hours”, but instead in “difficulty” or “effort”. However, members were having trouble with this expression because it was so fluffy.
